### Summary

<!--
Link the issue where this change was discussed (for example, "Closes #123" or
"Related to #123"). Explain the concrete problem and solution, then summarize
meaningful behavior or decisions — not changed files or commits. Call out breaking
changes, preserved behavior, scope boundaries, or stacked PRs when relevant.
-->

### Validation

<!--
List the exact commands you ran and useful manual coverage. Include relevant
results or limitations. Add screenshots or a short recording for visible UI
changes, and note when checks are not applicable.
-->

### Checklist

- [ ] I linked an issue with prior discussion confirming this change is wanted
- [ ] I kept this PR focused and did not bundle unrelated changes
- [ ] I ran `pnpm check` and `pnpm typecheck` successfully
- [ ] I ran `pnpm build` for changes that affect the app
- [ ] I added or updated documentation where relevant
- [ ] I included screenshots or a recording for visible UI changes
- [ ] My commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) for the DCO
